title: [BUG] Unclear dialog in UX:`Use this and all future MCP servers in this project`
body: Problem: The text here is super unintuitive. What does it mean? Is it just me that doesn't understand. What does this mean? `Use this and all future MCP servers in this project` To reproduce, in a new directory type: 1) `claude mcp add -t http example-mcp http://localhost:8765 -s project` 2) Then type `claude`
